AC9E2LA03.source_basis: Actual Y1/ABC/Oak structure and purpose methods, later Year2 ABC procedural/nonfiction repair tasks and LiteracyHub purpose/audience notes.
AC9E2LA03.design: Compare actual narrative/recount/information; procedure/opinion forms; actual short poem/response.

AC9E2LA04.source_basis: Current accepted pronoun methods + actual shared ABC cohesion/BC ellipsis records, independent residual delta review and Nov4 pronoun/recoverable-omission tasks. BC full explanation independently reopened.
AC9E2LA04.design: Trace personal/possessive references; expand recoverable omission; compare/repair unclear references.
AC9E2LA04.boundaries: Do not infer a person’s pronouns from a name/image. Provide the original noun/paragraph and clear speaker perspective. Recover meaning from connected context; distinguish omission from replacement with one/so and from three-dot punctuation. Transfer C1 mechanism only, not C1 language load.

AC9E2LA05.source_basis: Actual Y1 heading/contents/screen routes plus shared ReadingRockets index method and checked primary book page data; residual review closes original chapter/index method gap with explicit printed-page/PDF-index correction.

AC9E2LA05.boundaries: Supply complete miniature contents/index/page text and actual reachable screen targets. Same-keyword route must really resolve. A route description is not actual navigation. AC9E2LA06.source_basis: Actual shared Quill compound method, UVic independent-clause contrasts, later ABC/Oak and Nov4 result-clause tasks. Full UVic method independently reopened.
AC9E2LA06.design: Independent clauses, relation-specific coordination, build/repair. Retain the useful full worked reasoning lesson.
AC9E2LA06.boundaries: Two or more independent clauses, not merely any and. State intended relation when requiring one coordinator; and/but/so can be grammatical with differing relations. So introduces result after cause. Transfer older sources into short familiar Year2 clauses; do not import advanced taxonomy.

AC9E2LA07.source_basis: Actual Y1 contextual word-role methods, Year3 saved main/helping-verb contrasts and later Year2 LiteracyHub/K5/ABC grouping/task records.
AC9E2LA07.design: Articles/adjectives expand nouns, whole verb groups, useful group choices in complete sentences.
AC9E2LA07.boundaries: Nouns include ideas and verbs include states; groups may have one or several words. Do not label every nearby word part of a noun group or every predicate word part of the verb group. Supply cards and plain sentences; teach whole group before auxiliary/main technical extensions.

AC9E2LA09.source_basis: Actual Y1 context/category/vocabulary teaching plus later ABC GoatHerd/Notebook written activity records; primary Darug publisher vocabulary and teacher-note glossary method independently reopened.
AC9E2LA09.design: Topic precision, character vocabulary in context, verified attributed language in an actual named source.
AC9E2LA09.boundaries: Meaning must fit the intended context; a longer word is not inherently better. Supply paragraph, comparison words and topic definitions. Country/Place vocabulary is source-specific; do not claim Nura/yana are universally local, invent pronunciation or create cultural art/songlines.

AC9E2LA10.source_basis: Actual shared BritishCouncil title models, Australian StyleManual declared-style contrast, Waterloo list method and later Nov4 actual K5/ABC title/list tasks and source-key erratum.
